property_summary: For any deposit, a completed withdrawal pays the counterparty exactly the balance that was withdrawn (received value equals pre-call balance and the balance is then zero); the mutant leaves the zeroing after the external call so a re-entrant counterparty is paid the balance twice, receiving double the withdrawn amount.
change_summary: Move the zeroing of userBalance[msg.sender] to after the external call, enabling reentrancy double-withdrawal.
